summary: Section 319 Cr.P.C. summoning; standard: strong and cogent evidence, more than prima facie but short of conviction-level; reappreciation unnecessary after acquittals; no eye-witness, retracting witness, suspicion insufficient; remand improper; trial court's dismissal upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Hardeep Singh and Ors. Vs. State of Punjab & Ors., (2014) 3 SCC 92
Mohd. Shafi vs. Mohd. Rafiq, (2007) 14 SCC 544
Sagar vs. State of U.P. and Anr., (2022) 6 SCC 389
Kailash vs. State of Rajasthan and Anr., (2008) 14 SCC 51
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order set aside; application under Section 319 Cr.P.C. dismissed.
